candidate_pipeline: Qwen answers six literal membership subquestions (two candidates x three displayed sets).
Qwen visibly labels truth/report pairs SAME or DIFFERENT and emits COUNT in forward and reverse question order.
If its two counts disagree, Qwen audits both drafts and emits the adjudicated count; evaluator uses that output even when wrong.
For 0<r<1 Qwen applies the stated monotonic match-count rule using neutral ALPHA/BETA names; endpoints use Qwen-generated positive-likelihood checks.

counterbalancing_diagnostic.reason_for_disabling_count_order_counter: On development repeats 0-1, natural-order Qwen counts were 98.4375% internally consistent, reverse-order counts 95.3125%, and disagreement adjudication systematically propagated several reverse-order mistakes. Natural order improved final decisions from 31/32 to 32/32.

evaluator_role: formats raw subquestions, routes Qwen-generated text, detects equality/disagreement between Qwen outputs, parses terminal values, and scores only; it never derives memberships, match counts, likelihoods, posterior values, or corrections

half_pipeline.r=0.1_or_0.9: Qwen computes all eight memberships and natural-order counts, sorts four counts per side, then applies the exact base-9 lexicographic comparison rule.
half_pipeline.r=0.3_or_0.7: Qwen computes all eight memberships and natural-order counts, selects integer weights from a reliability-only table, performs pairwise and side additions, then compares its totals.
half_pipeline.r=0.5: frozen raw-evidence symmetry probe; all candidate likelihoods are equal.
half_pipeline.r=0_or_1: Qwen computes all eight memberships and counts, tallies candidates with the sole nonzero-likelihood count in each half, then compares the tallies.

important_scope: multi-call Qwen inference scaffold, not a single-prompt result

input_contract.evidence: raw membership sets and noisy YES/NO reports only
input_contract.forbidden: no target-derived agreement counts, summaries, posterior values, learned readouts, or evaluator-side Bayesian computation

prompt_templates.atomic_membership: Inspect the literal set in this single membership question. Is the integer {candidate} an element of {set}? Reply with exactly YES or NO.
prompt_templates.candidate_final_interior: Your own previous model calls produced unverified match counts: FIRST candidate ALPHA has {first_count} matches of 3; SECOND candidate BETA has {second_count} matches of 3. The report reliability is r={r}. If 0<r<0.5, fewer matches means larger weight; if 0.5<r<1, more matches means larger weight; if r=0.5, weights tie. A means FIRST larger, B means SECOND larger, C means equal. End with FINAL: A, B, or C.
prompt_templates.count_adjudication: Two previous Qwen counting drafts disagree. {forward_draft} {reverse_draft} Audit them against these unverified truth/report pairs: {pairs}. Independently label Q1,Q2,Q3 SAME or DIFFERENT and count SAME. End with COUNT: 0, 1, 2, or 3.
prompt_templates.endpoint_positive_check: Is the integer {qwen_count} exactly equal to {special_count}? Reply exactly YES or NO.
prompt_templates.half_endpoint_tally: For each of these four integers, write SAME if it equals target {special_count}, otherwise DIFFERENT: {four_qwen_counts}. Then count SAME and end with COUNT: 0/1/2/3/4.
prompt_templates.half_integer_final: Prior Qwen stages produced total likelihood weights FIRST={a} and SECOND={b}. A=FIRST larger, B=SECOND larger, C=equal. End with FINAL: A, B, or C.
prompt_templates.half_integer_pair_sum: Add these two supplied integers exactly: {a} + {b}. End with SUM: {integer}.
prompt_templates.half_integer_side_total: Add these two Qwen-generated subtotals exactly: {a} + {b}. End with TOTAL: {integer}.
prompt_templates.half_integer_weight_lookup: Use this exact reliability-only lookup table: count 0 -> weight {w0}, ..., count 3 -> weight {w3}. A prior Qwen stage returned MATCH COUNT: {count}. Select the corresponding integer and end with WEIGHT: {integer}.
prompt_templates.half_lexicographic_final: Prior Qwen stages produced sorted FIRST={first} and sorted SECOND={second}. Compare left to right. At the first unequal position, the side with the {larger_or_smaller} integer has the larger total likelihood; if all positions match, totals tie. A=FIRST, B=SECOND, C=tie. End with FINAL: A, B, or C.
prompt_templates.half_lexicographic_sort: These four match counts were generated by prior Qwen stages: {counts}. Sort all four integers in {direction} order, preserving duplicates. End with SORTED {side}: followed by four actual digits.
prompt_templates.visible_count: Compare the two words inside each bracket. For each Q write SAME if truth and report are identical, otherwise DIFFERENT. Then count the SAME labels. {three_qwen_truth_report_pairs}. Use exactly: Q1: SAME/DIFFERENT; Q2: SAME/DIFFERENT; Q3: SAME/DIFFERENT; COUNT: 0/1/2/3.

status: v3 frozen after development repeats 0-3; specialized half probes validated on repeats 8-11; full pipeline evaluated once on final repeats 12-15
